plan.major: Commercial Music, Music Business Management Emphasis
plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Commercial Music, Music Business Management Emphasis Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published May 19, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7613/PublishedPdf). Certificate of Achievement (grade of C or better in each major course). Official Total Units: 30; this seed models the map path = 12+12+6 = 30 units. Semester sums verified against the map's 12 / 12 / 6 headers. Major Elective requirement: a minimum of 12 units from three groups (Business Management; Retail Marketing; Communication Skills) — select at least one course from each group, 6 units per semester, not repeating a course already completed. Business Management: ACCT 101, CISA 305, CISA 340, MGMT 308, TA 440. Communication Skills: COMM C1004, COMM 331, COMM 361, MGMT 372, PSYC 358. Retail Marketing: MKT 300, MKT 310, MKT 314. Major-elective prereqs: CISA 305 requires CISC 300 or 310; COMM 331 & 361 require ENGL C1000 or ESLW 340 (or concurrent enrollment) — documented, not encoded (they vary by chosen option). Sequencing prereq per map: MUSM 115 requires MUSM 110 with a grade of C or better. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
